explication: TT-Metal is Tenstorrent’s software stack: TT-NN provides Python/C++ neural-network operations, TT-Metalium exposes low-level hardware programming, and model implementations compose these for inference and generation. A typical user supplies inputs to a model pipeline, which runs neural-network stages on device and returns generated output; other documented capabilities include model demos, training, and multi-device operation. The graph reflects README claims and the supplied source index/excerpts; unsampled subsystem links are omitted where their callers are not evidenced.
